title: Static by design
summary: Little or no scroll motion, as a deliberate choice: content is simply there. Motion is limited to hover color and loaders.
use_when: Loud visual systems (motion would be too much), austere ones (motion would be off-voice), or pages where the artifact is already the show.
recipe:
/* the whole motion system: */
a, button, .row { transition: color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), background-color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); }
specimen_html:
nothing moves on load or scroll · hover a row
